question: Which of the following is NOT the component of the capital expenditure of the Government?

options.text: Expenditure on the acquisition of machinery
Expenditure on the acquisition of land
Expenditure on the acquisition of building

solution:
The correct answer is **__Interest payments__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Capital expenditure**

 
 
• The **money that the government spends on developing buildings, machinery, equipment, schools and other infrastructure is known as capital expenditure.**
 
• Additionally, it **covers the costs made by the government for investments that will generate profits or dividends in the future,** such as land acquisition costs.
 
• According to the budget, the **government would spend $1,084,748 on capital projects in 2020–21.**
 
• The **2019-20 Budget's revised capital expenditure estimates came in at Rs. 1,059,472 crores,** while the 2018-19 Budget's actual capital expenditures came in at Rs. 915,670 crores.
 
• **Spending on investments or development is referred to as capital spending, **and these types of expenditures have long-term advantages.
 
• The following **expenses are included in capital expenditures:**
 
 
• Purchasing fixed and immovable assets
 
• Enhancing a current asset
 
• Restoring a current asset
 
• Repayment of a loan
